title: Project detail — check the applied treatment

steps.path: Checking the approved treatment on the real Project popup
steps.hint: Scroll inside each overlay, then try Meadow Mist, Halftone Dimension and a solid theme. Choose Other if the applied edge needs tuning.
steps.headline: Does the applied Project popup match the choice you made?
steps.risk: The 42px fade makes the last visible lines faint until you scroll. This check does not include Tags, Marketplace or other custom popups.

variants.label: Before (for reference)
variants.summary: Original 16px semibold title, full-width line, no content fade.

variants.label: Applied Project detail
variants.summary: Actual production shell: 16px medium title, 8% tapered divider, 42px fade with 4% side taper.
